inputs.text: (Masterpiece, high quality, 3D claymation, sculpted clay figure:1.3), Aardman studio style. A volumetric 3D female clay figure named Vee. Warm lemon-cream matte clay skin (#FFF3D4) with deep fingerprint textures. Auburn-copper wavy shoulder-length clay hair in chunky sculpted clumps. Large expressive wide-set hazel-brown clay eyes, tiny round button nose, gentle warm smile, slightly flushed pink clay cheeks. Thick-rimmed round black clay glasses. Wearing an oversized slouchy cocoa brown clay hoodie (#5D4037) with hood down and kangaroo pocket, sleeves bunched at wrists, blue denim clay shorts. Chibi stubby proportions. Cinematic lighting, soft shadows, subsurface scattering. Standing on a wooden workbench. Plain solid white studio background. Professional 8k macro photography of a physical toy figure.
